preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and len(S) >= 1 and all(c.islower() for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a non-empty string containing only lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len(S) + 1 - (1 if S == S[::-1] else 0)
postconditions.description: If S is already a palindrome, return_value is len(S) + 1 (all possible insertion positions). Otherwise, return_value is len(S) (all positions except the one that would make it a palindrome).
